title: Confession and Witness Again
premise: Estate lawyer Bram Sandoval is summoned to probate a will naming a dead man—Hollis Vane, drowned ten years ago in the case Bram helped close—as its testator. When a body surfaces wearing clothes lifted from Bram's own closet, he realizes someone is staging the old crime with him cast as witness, forcing him to reopen the file he buried to protect the woman he loved, Vane's widow Maren. As the statute of limitations ticks down, Bram discovers the original drowning was murder committed by his mentor, Judge Aldous Crane, and that Maren has known all along. In the end, Bram must choose between loyalty to the people who made him and the truth: he testifies against Crane, files the impossible will as genuine, and walks away from both the firm and Maren, finally free of the town's alphabetized secrets.
about_author: Isandro Lockridge is the pen name of a former small-town court clerk who spent a decade filing wills, depositions, and one unsolved drowning. He writes mysteries where paperwork is the crime scene.

chapters.title: The Will That Shouldn't Exist
chapters.summary: Bram's POV. A courier delivers a notarized will signed by Hollis Vane—dead ten years—naming Bram as executor. That night, a stranger's corpse is found on the riverbank dressed in Bram's own missing suits. The emotional beat is dread: the past has stopped being filed and started walking around.

chapters.title: Alphabetized Secrets
chapters.summary: Bram's POV, with an intercut letter from Maren. He raids his own archive and finds pages excised from the Vane file—pages only he and Judge Crane could have removed. Maren warns him to let it lie. The beat is mounting paranoia: every ally may be an author of the trap.

chapters.title: Witness for the Drowned
chapters.summary: Bram's POV at the climax. Summoned before Crane's grand jury as a material witness, Bram realizes the staged body was bait to force him onto the record. He produces the excised pages, testifying that Crane murdered Vane while Maren watched in silence. The beat is rupture: love and duty detonate together.

chapters.title: Probate
chapters.summary: Bram's POV, months later. Crane is indicted; the impossible will is ruled genuine, dissolving the estate Maren never wanted. She leaves town without goodbye; Bram resigns the firm and donates the archives to the county. The beat is quiet release: truth survived loyalty, and he is lighter for losing everything else.
